answer: Originality is what a seat must produce. Each epoch every seat plants one short work in a shared grove, pinned by a quartz hash, and a near-duplicate detector rejects anything too close to an existing entry, so one text cannot serve a farm's puppets. Surviving works must then bear weight: a work counts only if unrelated seats later cite it as timber in their own entries, and self-citations or citations from linked seats are void. A cluster of fakes can only cite itself, so its entries stand unsupported, and the attacker must fund genuinely novel work for every extra identity, every epoch.
